protocol.absolute_inner_target: .5e-8*||original b|| for every correction; not scaled by the new residual.
protocol.correction: From verified full r, q=rR-B.T Hb rS; solve current Sa v≈q; u=Hb(rS-Bv); add[u,v] to accumulated full x. Recompute literal b-Ax. Never reconstruct totalx from total-tail constraints.
protocol.prefix: H2 only in first4 inner actions of first cycle; H1 afterward and in all correction cycles. Current score/rebuild occurs only once in that prefix. FIRST8-prefix has FIRST8 factor from the start and never rebuilds.
protocol.accounting: Counts include each factor/setup/rebuild, boundary4 solve, Schur action, original verification and correction cross products. FPS distance pairs separately reported; existing FPS also evaluates Gaussian exp. No native runtime/fullmemory claim.
protocol.scope: One dense common-repair/confound gate, not a new iterative-refinement principle or feedback precision policy.
